limitations: WholeMeaning contains strong, explicit all-vector mathematical interpretation premises and completeness. It does not construct true Adams pages or prove raw-data realization.
The finite family must include all centers intended by an application; absent database centers are not proved zero.
Incoming coordinate surjectivity is sufficient and stronger than merely covering its image; it is explicitly documented.
Cardinality/additive equivalence is the exact stated result; no new topological convergence, permanence or stable-homotopy theorem follows.

Relation is defined using actual incoming map and actual addition, not finite equality. Forward direction uses all-incoming equation and current_add. Converse explicitly lifts every finite boundary coefficient through incoming_surjective and uses current injectivity. Missing incoming data cannot disappear.

Both quotient maps are constructed by Quot.lift on the derived cycle equivalence; actual_boundary_iff proves each is well-defined. Mutual inverse follows cycle bijectivity. With full checked HomologyComparison, quotient equality is exactly actual boundary relation, not merely a generated equivalence closure or coordinate identity.

Addition is independently defined on actual cycle representatives via the caller actual plus. Its cycle property and compatibility with both boundary representatives follow the all-current addition equation. Only afterward is the derived quotient/coordinate map proved to preserve this operation. There is no transported-addition tautology.

For arbitrary z, current surjectivity lifts finite inclusion(z); checked inclusion lies in the full kernel, hence is an actual cycle. next_cycle and projection*inclusion=id realize z. With next injectivity, nextCoordinateEquiv is derived and sends each cycle quotient to actual next(x). Every supplied actual Next value is represented by a current cycle. No next surjectivity or quotient-equivalence premise is present.

Derived center equivalences are combined pointwise then flattened over the full stated finite index set. Cardinality and all-combination addition preservation concern actual quotient/Next types under explicit WholeMeaning at every center. No SQL completeness outside this index set is inferred.
